name: bilimind-crew
description: A study crew that reads your lecture slides and past paper, plans the days you have, writes lessons in parallel, tests every code exercise and checks every answer against your slides.

displayDescription.en: Reads your slides and last year's paper, plans the days you have, writes interactive lessons in parallel, tests every code exercise and checks every answer against your slides.
displayDescription.zh: 读懂课件和往年试卷，按剩余天数规划复习，并行编写互动课程，测试代码练习，逐题对照课件核查答案

defaultInitPrompt.en: My Data Structures final is Thursday 9am. The slides and last year's paper are in this folder. I have 45 minutes a day. Get me ready.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我的数据结构期末考试在周四上午9点。课件和去年的试卷都在这个文件夹里。我每天有45分钟。帮我做好准备。

quickPrompts.en: Turn the SOP in this folder into a first-shift training course for our new boba shop staff.
